qualifications: Capture paints during rv_host_snapshot and encodes there; delivery is deferred to rv_run_loop_cycle, never inside the call. cancel/release/new document/host destroy keep a reached snapshot (rv_resource_* contract).
display-p3 returns RV_ERR_UNSUPPORTED on slim (ENABLE_DESTINATION_COLOR_SPACE_DISPLAY_P3 off); snapshot-display-p3 reports 0. No silent sRGB.

Layout snaps boxes to the host device pixels: at a scale other than the device scale, or a fractional device scale, edge pixels are partly covered; the probe asserts interior pixels with a half-device-pixel margin there.
The viewport snapshot always takes the CPU path (FlattenCompositingLayers), as rv_host_paint_rgba does without compositing.

JPEG default quality is the Skia encoder default, not Chromium toBlob 0.92; out-of-range/NaN quality equals the default (bytes identical). WEBP at quality 1 is lossless (VP8L) and embeds an ICCP chunk (VP8X).

Browser facade: an ordinary browser context has no DOM capture member (Chromium 156: drawElementImage/drawElement/layoutSubtree absent, getDisplayMedia unavailable); BrowserSnapshots reports Available=false and raises NotSupportedException.
